what_it_does: AI accelerators normally connect to each other and to the rest of the computer using electrical wires, which hit bandwidth and power limits at large scales. This paper describes Celestial AI's approach: embedding optical communication directly into a single chip. Instead of converting signals to light only at the chip boundary, they integrate the light-emitting modulators, light-receiving detectors, and light-guiding waveguides right into the main compute chip itself. This first-of-its-kind integration lets multiple accelerators talk at very high speeds using light while consuming less power than traditional electrical wiring.
